LanguageData.MX_Power_EquipmentInactive: This equipment's special combat bonuses are inactive. It can be used for ordinary combat. See its information panel for stats.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Original: Zhaoli's full abilities and default combat stats.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Original: Mingyuan's full abilities and default combat stats.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Balanced: Execution, healing, resurrection, Karma Links and growth, with moderate damage, bonuses and ability costs.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Balanced: Life Burn, Self Burn, Overburn, both bow forms, Time Burn, flame repair and rebirth, with moderate damage, layer gain and cooldowns.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Decorative: Focused on companionship, appearance and story. Abilities, growth, Karma income, linked death substitution and automatic rebirth are inactive. Equipment provides basic combat capability. Existing fields and enchantments end.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Decorative: Focused on companionship, appearance and story. Abilities and combat passives are inactive; the bow fires ordinary single arrows. Existing sustained effects end. Rebirth already in progress completes.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Duanzhan: Unleashes a circular slash followed by a stronger forward cut, favoring torso hits. An active Netherflame enchantment adds fire damage.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_DeathField: Creates a circular field 18 cells across. Units other than Zhaoli move 20% slower, receive bleeding wounds and gain 1 Death Pronouncement each second. Pronouncement rapidly fades outside the field. At 9 stacks, its last caster executes the target, gaining 1 Karma and 5 Deathward Shield layers.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Guiyi: Costs 1.2 Karma. Heals disease and injury, restores missing parts, and removes addiction, mechanical damage, scars and other treatable harmful conditions. Creates a Karma Link lasting 30 days. Cannot target Zhaoli herself or enemies.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Dingshu: Costs 2.4 Karma and channels for 1 hour to resurrect a corpse and fully repair its body. Creates a Karma Link and a Destiny Mark lasting 12 days. A marked target that dies again cannot be resurrected. Unavailable during raids.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Minghuo: Costs 3 Karma to enchant the current primary weapon for 1 day. Increases damage, armor penetration, accuracy and attack speed by 42.5%, adds 1.7 cells of range, and deals additional fire damage on melee hits.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Minshen: Costs 3 Karma. Suppresses enemies in a 13×13 area. Flesh targets suffer Life-Erosion for 5 seconds, taking 0.85 armor-ignoring blunt damage to the torso each second. 8.5% become mindless for 30 seconds; the rest move 68% slower. Mechanoids receive an EMP pulse.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Passives: Zhaoli gathers Karma through Death Pronouncement and links herself to recipients of her healing and resurrection. Up to 20 Karma Links last 30 days and can substitute for her death. Death fuels her growth. Without an available link, she leaves the world before returning.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Bow: Mingyuan's red-gold longbow. Focus charges for 6 seconds to detonate a visible enemy's Life Burn across the map. Radiation sweeps a 10-cell, 108° sector once per second, dealing 0.85 burn damage and adding Life Burn equal to 20.7% of each target's threshold.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Sword: Mingyuan's cinder blade, filled with searing scarlet flame. Its attacks interact with Self Burn, Overburn and Life Burn, and it improves melee dodge and weapon damage. See the equipment information panel for stats.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_AscendantFlameDash: Becomes rising flame and crosses up to 150 cells without line of sight, leaving a 3-cell-wide scorch trail for 15 seconds. Enemies along the path take 8.5 base burn damage and 27 Life Burn layers, are knocked back and stunned for 3 seconds. The trail adds Life Burn every 0.5 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_InstantCombustion: Releases a flash in a 30-cell radius. Each enemy's brain and eyes take 0.85 base burn damage, with a 12-second stun. Existing Life Burn doubles; unburning targets are ignited.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_BurningPillar: Places a burning core that grows from a 1-cell to a 15-cell radius over 10 minutes and lasts 3 hours. Burning is strongest near the center, cutting near the edge; burns add Life Burn. Each pulse deals base damage equal to 28.05% of a building's maximum health. Movement commands unlock after 10 minutes.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_TimeBurn: Burns away the target's biological age over 1 hour, killing it when age reaches zero. Mechanoids collapse into steel and plasteel; buildings return all their raw materials. Charges for 9.6 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_AshesOfSelf: Costs 50% blood and grants 100 Self Burn layers. A moving 5×5 field surrounds Mingyuan for 15 seconds, dealing 0.85 base burn damage and adding Life Burn every 0.5 seconds. It consumes buildings and animals, heals wounds and scars, and recovers Self Burn. Overburn begins above 300 Self Burn layers.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_LifeBurn: A growing flame that wounds the body, damages equipment, drains needs and burns away age. Its burst threshold depends on the target's health scale; Long Rainbow can detonate it early. On death, the flame spreads to nearby targets.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_SelfBurn: Accumulated flame increases melee, ability and ranged damage, movement, attack and work speed. It grows while drafted and fades otherwise. Above 300 layers, Overburn further strengthens direct damage and Life Burn gain while draining the flame reserve.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_BurningBody: A burning body with heightened consciousness, no physiological needs and a 1.5% ordinary incoming damage factor. Fire and explosion immunity restores the body. Control effects are cleared; hits grant brief invulnerability and Self Burn. Attacks and retaliation apply Life Burn, and the body fully repairs itself periodically.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_ProtectiveFlameShield: A pale flame reserve for bodily repair, with no damage absorption. Each point restores one missing part or heals all wounds and scars on one part. Stable Self Burn can replenish the reserve; Overburn drains it.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_RebirthFlame: At the brink of death, Mingyuan releases an explosion that damages and stuns nearby enemies, then leaves temporarily. She returns fully restored when the flame reforms.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Shield: Absorbing a unit through Death Pronouncement grants 5 Deathward Shield layers. Taking damage consumes 1 layer, including each damage-over-time tick. Layers record accumulated pronouncements and do not absorb damage.
LanguageData.MX_Power_BalancedEquipment: Dedicated armor that provides protection and equipped bonuses. See its information panel for stats.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_WarpFeather: After a brief charge, a flash at Neiyu's feet produces 84–128 Milira feathers.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_ThunderMarkedStorm: Marks hostile targets within a 3-cell radius. After a delay, each target receives 3–5 lightning strikes, each dealing 51 base damage and 17 EMP damage.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_Bow_ArrowBarrage: Requires bow form. Charges for 5 seconds, then fires 64 arrows along the selected direction, covering the battlefield ahead.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_Flower_BlessingField: Requires flower form. Heals all wounds and scars on allies in the target area, improves mood, movement and immunity gain, and reduces incoming damage.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_Flower_ToxinGarden: Requires flower form. Inflicts food poisoning on enemies in the target area, with an 8.5% chance to cause berserk rage.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_Sword_Skyfall: Requires sword form. Rises into the air, marks the landing area, then descends at high speed, dealing armor-ignoring area damage and making enemies vulnerable.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_Sword_ExecuteHead: Requires sword form. Retreats briefly, then dashes to decapitate the selected target. Targets that cannot be decapitated receive a powerful slash.
